about: Every record of D3's files (data/local, data/state-lower, data/state-upper, data/measure, data/primary) that moved in the district checks' third pass and the governors' counts, against 0094391 (this step's code alone; its data are main's at 72d1d60): the orchestrator's orders of 2026-11-13 04:44 (a name's two spellings summed), 05:15 (Indiana 2016's Senate 36 on MEDSL's count, the state's count read candidate by candidate, two counts within 0.4% against an unmarked state count, the over-seats test for every record) and 05:38 (a county whose rows are all zero is missing); data/local/REPORT.md section 35. The rest follow through the fits: Indiana's, Kentucky's and West Virginia's later legislative records read their chambers' leans, and the local calibration moves a little. The run's own stamps (a commit, a read time) are left out; files whose only change was a stamp were restored. Written by worker D3.

codes.G: a record no longer written (joined into another, or replaced)
codes.R: not computed before or after, the reason changed
